ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
